title: Finite-support Wasserstein ambiguity over joint service-failure states
purpose: Compare nominal, Wasserstein worst-case expected-loss and Wasserstein minimax-regret decisions over complete joint service-failure distributions with fixed source forecasts, outcomes, actions and cost profiles.

source.linkage_rule: Each NRES-013 row preserves its exact NRES-009 source case ID, evaluator-owned observed state and complete candidate joint distribution. Each source case is crossed with every ambiguity-radius tier.

protocol.state_encoding: Bit i is the binary breach indicator for service_catalog[bit_index=i]; all 2^d joint states are enumerated.

ground_metric.name: weighted_hamming
ground_metric.definition: d(s,t)=sum_i w_i*1[s_i!=t_i], with finite strictly-positive weights defining transport distance only.

protocol.ambiguity_set: P_epsilon(p)={q in simplex on complete joint state support: W_1,d(q,p)<=epsilon}.
protocol.radius_interpretation: Synthetic sensitivity parameter in weighted-Hamming units; not a confidence level or coverage guarantee.
protocol.robust_dual: sup_q E_q[loss]=inf_{lambda>=0}{lambda*epsilon+sum_i p_i*max_j(loss(s_j)-lambda*d(s_i,s_j))}; exact finite piecewise-linear dual evaluated at all upper-envelope breakpoints.
protocol.decision_rule: Nominal minimizes E_p loss; Wasserstein expected-loss minimizes the exact worst-case expected loss; Wasserstein minimax-regret minimizes exact worst-case expected statewise regret versus the best feasible action once state is known.
protocol.action_loss: resource_units*resource_unit_cost + sum over breached services [service_breach_cost_i*(prepared_residual_fraction if prepared else 1)].
protocol.resource_rule: Actions above profile max_resource_units are excluded from all policies and perfect-information calculations.
protocol.tie_break: Action catalog order; tolerance-level ties retain first feasible action.
protocol.aggregation_rule: Keep each profile and radius separate; no composite robustness or resilience score.

interpretation_guardrails: All cases, forecasts, observations, actions, costs, metric weights and radii are fictional synthetic development inputs.
The 32 rows are eight NRES-009 source cases crossed with four radius settings, not 32 independent observations.
Source outcomes and candidate forecasts are copied exactly and retain source case identities.
The radius is a sensitivity parameter, not a calibrated confidence set.
The weighted-Hamming metric is fixed; no learned or loss-aware metric is claimed.
This is a single 24-hour joint-state decision benchmark, not cascade propagation, recovery or multi-stage recourse.
The perfect-information reference is a statewise lower bound, not a deployable policy.
Fixture conformance does not demonstrate real-world readiness, causal effects, legal authority, forecast superiority or SOTA performance.
No political belief, loyalty, identity, willingness to serve, personal suitability or personal data is scored.
